summary: Kept. LBL self-service campground on Taylor Bay (Lake Barkley): $10/night per unit, self-pay, year-round, vault toilets, boat ramp, no hookups; no rec.gov listing; no closure. Lakefront holds only for the south-end pad(s) (~1.7 m above summer pool, open grass); the east loop pads are a view.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront: confirmed for the south end only, with a caveat. No site numbers exist (self-service, choose a site). The south pad with a table at ~36.88303,-88.01963 stands at 111.15 m (3DEP), ~1.7 m above Lake Barkley's 359-ft summer pool (109.4 m), with open grass falling to the water within ~15-20 m - passes the kayak test. The east-side loop pads (36.88357,-88.01954 / 36.88383,-88.01944) are 5-6 m above summer pool, ~36 m back down a ~16 deg bank behind a tree belt = view. Suggest the note name the caveat ('only the few south-end pads sit on the water; the loop's east pads look over it from a wooded bank').
NOTE: the stored '~8-10 lakefront sites (boats can tie up) + ~8-10 wooded sites' has no official source; LBL gives no site count. Not written to sites.
PIN 36.88397,-88.02034 is on the loop entrance; fine.
PHONE 270-924-2000 is LBL's main line (no campground phone); WEBSITE the self-service page (200) is the official page; no per-campground page exists (facility/taylor-bay* 404).
